dimensions.rationale: Each genuinely distinct license tier or classification named across AK, AL, AR, and CO is kept as a separate entry; journeyman and journeyworker plumber are merged as spelling variants of the same tier; restricted lifetime master plumber is folded into master plumber as a sub-variant; medical gas piping fitter is kept separate because multiple states treat it as a distinct credential rather than a plumber sub-tier; plumbing contractor is retained as a distinct business-entity registration level that several states explicitly define; mechanical administrator (AK) is kept separate as it is an AK-specific administrative/qualifying license tier.

dimensions.rationale: The union was drawn from all states' sentences; items describing pathways to satisfy the experience requirement for journeyman (or equivalent) plumber licensure were retained, including items appearing only in exclusion or conditional contexts; synonymous phrasings across states were merged into single canonical entries while genuinely distinct mechanisms (e.g., apprenticeship program completion vs. raw years of on-the-job experience, reciprocity for journeyman vs. master, college training vs. manufacturer training) were kept separate; items solely about supervision ratios, business registration, bond requirements, and disciplinary procedures unrelated to satisfying the experience requirement were excluded.
